title: Isolation of exosomal RNA from urine using the Qiagen miRNeasy Micro kit
protocol: Thaw samples on ice.
Transfer 500 µL of urine into a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 5x volumes of QIAzol Lysis Reagent.
Vortex for 5 s.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Add 1x volume chloroform.
Shake vigorously for 15 s.
Incubate for 3 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge sample for 15 min at 12,000 x g at 4°C.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Measure the aqueous phase and add 1.5x volumes of 100% ethanol.
Mix gently and thoroughly.
Assemble a MinElute spin column in a new collection tube.
Load up to 700 µL of the mixture onto the column.
Spin for 15 s at 1,000 x g at room temperature.
Discard flow-through.
Repeat steps until entire sample has been loaded.
Add 700 μL Buffer RWT to the RNeasy MinElute spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 s at ≥ 8000 x g at room temperature.
Discard the flow-through.
Pipette 500 μL Buffer RPE onto the RNeasy MinElute spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 s at ≥ 8000 x g to wash the column.
Discard the flow-through.
Pipette 500 μL fresh 80% ethanol onto the RNeasy MinElute spin column.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at ≥ 8000 x g (≥10,000 rpm) at room temperature to wash the column.
Discard the collection tube with the flow-through.
Transfer the RNeasy MinElute spin column into a new 2 mL collection tube.
Open the lid of the spin column, and centrifuge at full speed for 5 minutes to dry the membrane.
Discard the collection tube with the flow-through.
Transfer the RNeasy MinElute spin column into a new 1.5 mL collection tube.
Add 14 μL RNase-free water directly to the center of the spin column membrane.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 100 x g followed by 1 minute at full speed to elute the RNA.
Aliquot 5 µL into a new microcentrifuge tube for QC analyses.
